.TH "NPM-RUN-SCRIPT" "1" "March 2026" "NPM@10.9.7" ""
.SH "NAME"
\fBnpm-run-script\fR - Run arbitrary package scripts
.SS "Synopsis"
.P
.RS 2
.nf
npm run-script <command> \[lB]-- <args>\[rB]

aliases: run, rum, urn
.fi
.RE
.SS "Description"
.P
This runs an arbitrary command from a package's \fB"scripts"\fR object. If no \fB"command"\fR is provided, it will list the available scripts.
.P
\fBrun\[lB]-script\[rB]\fR is used by the test, start, restart, and stop commands, but can be called directly,
